questions.answer: Local data remains under the user-controlled application folder; the inspected app has no unified deletion/export workflow or provider-data deletion operation.

questions.question: Telemetry default
questions.answer: No ADE telemetry: the README and site say no telemetry, and a bounded search of the pinned source found no analytics or crash client. Token-usage tracking stays local, and the optional update check goes to GitHub's releases API.

questions.question: Telemetry off switch location
questions.answer: Not applicable in practice: the scoped app sends no ADE telemetry, so there is nothing to switch off and no off-switch location is recorded.

limitations: Local file behavior does not establish model-provider retention or training terms.

claims.answer: Free, no paid tier.

sources.title: TernaryCode README
sources.locator: Highlights, Install, Quick start, Features, Privacy, License
sources.finding: Native Rust workspace for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI and OpenCode across projects; hook-backed Needs input, Running, Done and Failed status; Inbox; multi-account failover with 5-hour and weekly limits; agent-driven browser; diffs, Commit & Push and pull request; worktrees; phone companion over Wi-Fi; no cloud account or telemetry; MIT.

sources.title: tc-core agent.rs
sources.finding: Agent kinds Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini (Gemini CLI, gemini), Antigravity and Custom, a program the user marks as an agent in a custom preset.

sources.title: tc-agent sessions.rs
sources.finding: Lists an agent's earlier sessions in a project from the agent's own files for resume; OpenCode sessions are in a database and not listed.

sources.title: tc-agent mcp.rs
sources.locator: browser tool list and answer_with lines 155-198; introductory platform comment cross-checked against src/browser.rs supported()
sources.finding: The pane-scoped MCP server exposes browser navigation and interaction tools when TC_BROWSER_AGENTS is enabled. Its introductory macOS-only comment disagrees with the platform implementations; src/browser.rs supports macOS, Windows WebView2 and Linux X11/WebKitGTK.

sources.title: tc-agent guard.rs
sources.finding: Claude Code and Codex PreToolUse hook refuses tool calls that would open another browser, keeping agents on the TernaryCode browser unless the user named that browser.

sources.title: tc-git ship.rs
sources.finding: Commit box commits changes, pushes the branch and opens a pull request; git runs non-interactively and a step needing a password stops with an error.

sources.title: app ship.rs
sources.finding: With gh (GitHub) or glab (GitLab) the pull request is created; without, its form opens in the Browser panel; title written from the agent task.

sources.title: history_ui.rs
sources.locator: module comment and forge rows, lines 1-10, 253, 320-365
sources.finding: History panel shows commits on a rail, Fetch, and the forge's open pull requests and pipelines.

sources.title: tc-git worktree.rs
sources.finding: Creates a git worktree on a new branch from a base.

sources.title: app worktree.rs
sources.finding: New worktrees can copy chosen ignored top-level files (for example env files) from the project; sidebar lists a project's worktrees.

sources.title: companion.rs
sources.locator: module comment, pairing token and token_hash device map
sources.finding: Embedded local HTTP and Server-Sent Events server for phone pairing and remote monitoring and control; per-device bearer tokens stored as SHA-256 hashes.

sources.title: ade.rs
sources.locator: module comment; failover mode Auto at line 866
sources.finding: Multi-account profiles with isolated environments, automatic and manual rate-limit failover with session resume, token usage telemetry and session history indexing, companion snapshot publishing and remote commands.

sources.title: monitor_ui.rs
sources.finding: Accounts and usage popover shows each agent account's usage at a glance.

sources.title: handoff.rs
sources.finding: Update restart on macOS and Linux execs the new version in-process so pane programs keep running and agents carry on.

sources.title: app.rs restore

sources.finding: On launch the app restores saved panes asleep and starts their shells when shown.

sources.title: notify_native.rs

sources.title: cli.rs

sources.title: TernaryCode recovery-model
sources.locator: Workspace, ProjectSave, PaneSave, Settings; src/actions.rs action enum; searched src and crates for issue tracker, backlog, epic, specification, acceptance, coordinator, SSO, cron and webhook.
sources.finding: Persistent app records are projects, worktrees, tabs, panes, settings, profiles and paired devices. Action and model inventories contain no task/issue/plan/spec store, dependency dispatch, product coordinator, recurring-work scheduler, organisation membership, RBAC or SSO. Browser delegate symbols are native UI plumbing, not agent delegation.

sources.title: TernaryCode recovery-runtime
sources.locator: Action enum; src/app.rs pane launch/restore; src/ade.rs profile failover and logs; src/ship.rs ship plan; src/worktree.rs setup/merge. Search src/crates for schedule, timeout, max_turns, token budget, cost, export and import.
sources.finding: The application starts local pane processes. No remote execution backend, container/VM runtime, run scheduler, task budgets, artifact gallery, workspace import/export command or delivery-check gate is present. Account quota failover is separate from task budgeting; ship plans run commit, push and PR steps without a product-owned test/spec gate. Git and browser operations have their own timeouts.

sources.title: TernaryCode recovery-browser
sources.locator: supported lines 90-107; crates/tc-agent/src/mcp.rs answer_with lines 155-198; crates/tc-web/src/main.rs Linux helper
sources.finding: Browser panes use macOS WebKit, Windows WebView2 when installed, or the Linux X11/WebKitGTK helper. MCP tool exposure depends on pane credentials and TC_BROWSER_AGENTS, not a macOS compile gate. The mcp.rs introductory macOS-only comment is stale.

sources.title: TernaryCode recovery-worktree
sources.finding: Worktree setup copies selected ignored files and can run a user setup command before starting the agent only if that command succeeds. The Changes panel has Merge into base, which types git merge --no-ff --no-edit in the parent project terminal; conflicts remain terminal work. This is local branch merging, not a PR merge or deployment.

sources.title: TernaryCode recovery-handoff
sources.locator: switch_pane_profile_and_resume lines 925-1060; src/profiles.rs profile_env and write_handoff_context
sources.finding: Same-provider switching copies the session when possible and uses native resume; otherwise it writes a redacted task and terminal-tail summary for the next profile, including cross-provider switches. This does not transfer a complete conversation or a named human identity. Optional profile API keys and extra environment variables are injected per launch.

sources.title: TernaryCode recovery-data
sources.locator: push_agent_log lines 334-354; crates/tc-core/src/persist.rs write_private/save_json; src/profiles.rs write_handoff_context
sources.finding: Agent Logs retains the latest 300 structured events in memory, tagged with project, pane, profile, time and level. Workspace/settings JSON and failover handoff files are local; atomic private writes use 0700 directories and 0600 new files on Unix. No timed deletion policy for workspace/settings/handoff data or product-managed provider-data deletion is established.

sources.title: TernaryCode pinned telemetry source inspection
sources.locator: Bounded search of src/, crates/ (tc-agent, tc-core, tc-doc, tc-git, tc-lsp, tc-term, tc-web), scripts/, site/ and README for telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Segment, Sentry, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Bugsnag, Datadog and crash reporting, excluding Cargo.lock and target/; network hosts reviewed; src/update.rs lines 90-100 (update feed); src/profiles.rs and src/ade.rs telemetry-named local usage structures
sources.finding: No analytics, crash-reporting or usage-upload client is present. Telemetry-named code in profiles.rs and ade.rs tracks local token usage and rate limits for the top-bar pill and phone companion. The only product-initiated outside request is the update check to the GitHub releases API; pull requests use the user's own gh or glab.
